I will test a trimmed mean to provide robustness against extreme forecast errors from individual models, specifically trimming the top and bottom 20% of predictions.

The current leader is DBA (score 0.8799). A simple inverse-error weighted pool of top-5 models scored 0.9283, which is worse. I will test a `softmax_neg_error` weighting on the full pool to see if a probabilistic combination of all models provides better robustness than the top-5 inverse-error approach, leveraging the full ensemble's diversity given the medium predictability and mixed regime.
